goal: Decide what an enacted intervention did to the series it was for, by the same control chart that raised the signal, so the community learns which interventions work before anything is said about them.

app.name: uor-intervention-effect
app.title: Intervention effect
app.purpose: Decide, for one enacted intervention, whether the series it was for returned to its control limits, kept moving the way it signalled, moved the other way, or has too few weeks since to say, from the signal and the weeks after enactment judged against the limits frozen at the signal.

fields.name: signal
fields.means: the uor-intervention-signal answer the intervention was proposed for

fields.name: after
fields.means: the uor-intervention-signal answer for the complete weeks after enactment, against the control limits of the baseline the signal was judged on

fields.name: span
fields.means: full: at least nine complete weeks since enactment, the length of ISO 7870-2:2023 test 2; partial: fewer

meanings.restored: the series is back within its frozen limits with no run for nine weeks
meanings.persists: the series still signals the way it did
meanings.reversed: the series now signals the other way
meanings.pending: too few weeks since enactment to say it is back in control

rules.why: ISO 7870-2:2023: the special cause still acts
ISO 7870-2:2023: the special cause still acts
ISO 7870-2:2023 tests 1 and 2: a special cause acts the other way
ISO 7870-2:2023 tests 1 and 2: a special cause acts the other way
ISO 7870-2:2023 test 2 needs nine points before a series can be said to have no run

app.otherwiseWhy: ISO 7870-2:2023: nine weeks within the limits with no run is a process back in statistical control

properties.why: control is never claimed on fewer than nine weeks
a fall that keeps falling persists
